papers.title: Geometry of Lightning Self-Attention: Identifiability and Dimension
findings: Section3.4 defines positive injective normalization S with S(0)=1 for bilinear self-attention. Theorem3.9 characterizes the single-layer parameter fiber; AppendixA.8 starts from equality on all input matrices.
The abstract separates the polynomial unnormalized attention analysis from a normalized extension. Deep normalized identifiability is stated as a conjecture in3.10.
limitations: Read the identified arXiv v3 updated11Jun2026 carrying an ICLR2025 header, not an independently matched proceedings PDF.
Only pages1,8,17 read; other results/supplements and complete generic-fiber proofs not audited.
The Q-RMEA scalar relation head, Born normalization and a two-point synthetic input distribution differ from the theorem model and quantifier. No refutation or transfer theorem is established.

papers.title: Quantum state tomography via compressed sensing
findings: Theorem1 uses iid uniform Pauli measurement settings and trace-norm minimization to recover a low-rank state with the stated setting complexity.
The proof setup and concentration arguments depend on the operator sampling ensemble.
limitations: Only pages1-2 of the2009v1 original read, not the whole proof or later version.
Task/value-dependent operators induced by learned Q-RMEA logits are not automatically iid Pauli measurements; no sample complexity or reconstruction guarantee is imported.

papers.title: How Attentive are Graph Attention Networks?
findings: Definitions3.1-3.2 distinguish static and universally dynamic attention; these are exclusive but not complements.
Theorem1 proves query-independent rankings for the original GAT scorer; GATv2 reorders nonlinearity and linear maps, Theorem2 states a dynamic-family guarantee.
limitations: Only the original2021v1 pages1,3-5 read, not AppendixA or the whole evaluation.
An entity-dependent rank reversal is weaker than Definition3.2 and supplies neither novelty nor a full-model classification separation. Q/dephased/real_overlap may all exhibit it.

prior_bank: Reuse14 earlier scoped original readings; no silent whole-paper certification.
source_interpretation: These originals bound possible identifiability/tomography/role-coupling claims. They do not supply a novel Q-RMEA contribution or demonstrate task utility.
